1) Exchange Ratio: 0.9693 shares of Parent Class A Common Stock per Company Class A or Class B Common Stock. 2) Per Share Cash Amount: $96.00 in cash per share. 3) Cash in lieu of fractional shares of Parent Class A Common Stock. 4) Vested RSU related: Converted RSU Cash Award (cash equal to the Per Share Cash Amount) and Converted RSU Equity Award (shares equal to Exchange Ratio times Unvested RSU shares). 5) Unvested/Equity-linked: Converted Option Cash Award (cash equal to Per Share Cash Amount minus the exercise price times Cash Consideration Ratio) and Converted Option Equity Award (shares equal to Unvested Option shares times Exchange Ratio with adjusted exercise price). 6) Note: CVRs are not described in the provided text; returns focus on RSU/Option conversions and the stated Merger Consideration components.
0.9693 of a share of Parent Class A Common Stock per Company share, plus $96.00 in cash per share; the Merger Consideration comprises (1) 0.9693 Parent Class A Common Stock per share and (2) $96.00 cash per share, with cash in lieu of fractional shares (Section 2.03(v)).
